status: planned -- the producer, registry contract and both DDLs LEAD live Glue by these 44 columns; apply is an orchestrator AWS step
blocker_measured: silver_pink_sheet carried 16 of the World Bank Pink Sheet's 71 monthly series. MEASURED 2026-08-20 by enumerating the 'Monthly Prices' sheet of BOTH raw releases held in S3 (raw/production/source=world_bank_pink_sheet/release=2026M05 and release=2026M07): 72 columns = 1 date + 71 price series, and the 71 header strings are BYTE-IDENTICAL between the two releases. The live silver object (silver/pink_sheet/part-000.parquet, 798 rows 1960-01..2026-06, 36 columns) carries 16 value series + 16 _zscore_5yr twins + date/year/month/latest_release_ym. The other 55 source series were never projected and nothing in the pipeline said so -- the same projection-failure class as the PSD 13-of-63 census.
mechanism: Direct ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMNS (Athena/Hive), mirroring the F024 CONAB additive precedent. All 44 columns are APPENDED AFTER latest_release_ym (catalog positions 37-80), so the 36 pre-F063 columns keep ordinals 0-35 EXACTLY. This is a pure ADD COLUMNS and never a REPLACE COLUMNS: the transform's SILVER_COLUMNS is built as _PRE_F063_COLUMNS + new values + new z-twins precisely so that catalog order, hand-DDL order and the producer's parquet footer order all agree without touching a single shipped ordinal. Logical regrouping (all values together, all z-scores together) was considered and REJECTED for exactly this reason -- it would have put 36 live ordinals at risk for cosmetics. The table is partition_mode=flat with 0 registered partitions, so there is no partition side to repair.

units_note: Every agricultural leg is USD/tonne. Eleven of the governed source series are published by the World Bank in USD/kg (world/EU/US sugar, cocoa, both coffees, orange, beef, chicken, cotton A-Index, rubber RSS3) and the producer scales each x1000 via the explicit _SERIES_UNIT_SCALE rule -- extending the ONE pre-existing precedent (sugar_world_usd_kg -> raw_sugar_world_usd_t). The result is a table with a single agricultural unit, which is what makes the world/EU/US sugar policy wedge a direct subtraction instead of a 1000x footgun. tsp_usd_mt and copper_usd_mt follow the fertilizer/mineral `_usd_mt` convention. blended_npk_index is UNCHANGED (urea + DAP + potassium only); TSP is deliberately NOT a component, because changing the index would rewrite a live published column.
sequencing_note: Order: (1) apply this ALTER; (2) re-run raw->bronze WITH --force-overwrite -- `python jobs/batch/pink_sheet_task.py --force-overwrite` -- because jobs/batch/pink_sheet_task.py:65 skips on `bronze_is_current`, and the raw objects have NOT changed, so a bare re-fire would skip BOTH releases, exit 0, and land nothing; this is the single easiest way to ship the widening and see no new data; (3) re-run bronze->silver canonical (jobs/batch/pink_sheet_silver_task.py --publish-mode canonical). Because every WB release restates 1960-onward in full, ONE re-extracted release backfills all 798 months of all 22 new legs -- there is no backfill job and no re-chunk. (4) re-snapshot reports/silver_readiness/20260712_p65impl/tables/silver_pink_sheet.json from live Glue + the rewritten parquet footer and re-run scripts/silver/gen_registry_from_baseline.py + scripts/silver/generate_ddls_from_registry.py --write to confirm zero diff. Until (1) lands, jobs/utils/validate_athena_ddl_drift.py and the F011 diff report will show silver_pink_sheet as hand-DDL-leads-Glue; that auto-resolves on apply.
arm_vs_flip_note: ARM-not-FLIP does NOT apply the way it did to the PSD slug widening. There is no new partition, no new table and no new slug to arm: this is ONE table gaining columns, and a SINGLE producer fire fills every one of them for the full 1960-2026 history. That is exactly why the numbers-card metric widening ships in the SAME commit as the transform -- the card must never advertise a column the next fire will not produce, and here the next fire produces all 44. The only ordering hazard is the reverse one: the card and DDL lead live Glue between commit and apply, so a numbers query naming a new metric returns an Athena error (column not found) rather than a wrong number. Fail-closed, and it resolves on step (1).
floors_note: min_nonnull_frac stays at the uniform provisional 0.5 with SIX measured per-column overrides (up from two). The four new ones are MEASURED from the widened producer run over both releases (798 rows), never inferred -- the OP-8 inferred-floor lesson: palm_kernel_oil_usd_t 0.4586 -> floor 0.36, its z twin 0.4148 -> 0.33, sunflower_oil_usd_t 0.3609 -> 0.28, its z twin 0.3170 -> 0.25. The other 40 new columns clear 0.5 on their own (weakest: groundnuts_usd_t_zscore_5yr 0.6554).
known_limitation: barley_usd_t and sorghum_usd_t were DISCONTINUED by the World Bank after 2020-08. They still measure 0.9123 non-null because 60 years of history dwarfs the missing tail, so NO non-null floor can detect that staleness -- the value-census gate will pass them forever. The warning lives in the numbers card notes instead. Do not mistake a passing floor for a live series.
rollback_note: ALTER TABLE leviathan_dev.silver_pink_sheet REPLACE COLUMNS (...the 36 pre-F063 columns...) to drop the 44 from the catalog; OR leave the columns and revert the numbers card metrics (config-only, no redeploy, fail-closed). The stored parquet is unaffected either way. Note the producer would then be writing 80 physical columns into a 36-column catalog, which Athena tolerates (it reads parquet by NAME) but which the F011 diff report will flag until the registry is regenerated from a re-captured snapshot.
